Qantas Points you will earn on eligible purchases:
• 0.75 Qantas Points per $1 spent on eligible purchases up to and including $3,000 per statement period.
• 0.5 Qantas Points per $1 spent on eligible purchases over $3,000 up to and including $25,000 per statement period.
• No Qantas Points earned over $25,000 per statement period.
ANZ Falcon provides 24/7 anti-fraud protection. If we identify any unusual transactions, we’ll contact you to help protect your money.

From 2 December 2025, ANZ Instalment Plans will no longer be offered on eligible ANZ Credit Cards. From this date, customers will not be able to set up new ANZ Instalment Plans for eligible credit card purchases or balances.

If you have an active ANZ Instalment Plan as of 2 December 2025, it will not be affected by this change. You can continue to view and manage your active ANZ Instalment Plans and make instalment payments via the ANZ App.

Earn 25,000 bonus Qantas Points with your new ANZ Frequent Flyer Platinum credit card when you spend $3,500 on eligible purchases in the first 4 months from approval. Plus, earn an additional 25,000 bonus Qantas Points when you keep your card for over 12 months.

You are not eligible for the initial bonus Qantas Points if you currently hold or have held an ANZ Rewards or ANZ Frequent Flyer credit card in the last 24 months. T&Cs, eligibility criteria, fees and charges apply (including an annual fee, currently $295).

We charge 3.5% of any overseas transaction using your ANZ Credit Card. The amount on which the fee is charged may 
include fees and other charges related to the overseas transaction (excluding any Cash Advance Fee that may be charged). 
Overseas Transaction Fees are not charged on ANZ Rewards Travel Adventures Credit Cards. 
See your letter of offer for details (including how we calculate the fee and when it applies)
fees.name: Overseas Transaction Fee

fees.additionalInfo:
We charge an Overlimit Fee if: 
we allow you to exceed your credit limit so that a debit can be processed; and you have consented to being charged the Overlimit Fee (or if your account was opened before 18 June 2012, you have not opted out of the overlimit fee, or if you have opted out, you have since consented), and have not withdrawn that consent, at the time we allow the overlimit. 
The Overlimit Fee is only charged once in any statement period and isn’t charged if you hold an ANZ Access Basic Account.

fees.additionalInfo: Any transaction on your account which is a Cash Advance attracts a fee. The fee applies even if your account has a positive balance. A Cash Advance is not just a cash withdrawal. Transactions which are Cash Advances are described in ANZ’s Credit Cards Conditions of Use. We charge a 3.5% fee, subject to: • a minimum fee of $4; and • a maximum fee of $50. See your letter of offer for details as to how we calculate the fee. For ANZ Rewards Travel Adventures cards, we won’t charge a Cash Advance Fee on cash withdrawals made from a branch or ATM located outside Australia.
